target_instruction: Export all my Simple Note notes to "~/backups/notes/" directory in my file system. The files should be named according to the note title, replacing white space with "_", and the extension should be ".md".

retrieval_results.content: Policy workflow_export_notes_v1: enumerate all notes; fetch each full content; transform title whitespace to underscores plus .md; create one file per note under the directory named in the current instruction; do not update or remove unrelated files.
